title: After /posture, tool_search searched the old posture and enabled tools stayed unusable
observed: With /posture ops, a Grafana request found no Grafana tools and the model said no Grafana MCP was connected (81 tools connected); tool_search kept the startup posture and a gate state /posture had replaced, so tools it enabled were refused
expected: tool_search and the prompt's server index follow the current posture; enabled tools are callable
